2.petitionerRequestSummary: Original PGRS application (Grievance No. SKL20240819426, filed 19-08-2024, category: Revenue > Settlement Under Estate Abolition Act > Fair Adangal Copy) submitted by Ponnada Jogarao, Nellimarla village, Vizianagaram district, addressed to the Tahsildar, Amadalavalasa. The petitioner states that in Akkivaram village, Amadalavalasa mandal, Survey Nos. 3/2, 10/1A, 10/1B and 34/15 (3.13 acres), land acquired through a registered gift settlement (Document No. 2533/1962) has not been handed over to the rightful pattadars despite the land being in the possession of Kote Appalaswamy's son Achanna and family, and requests departmental action for justice. 2.remarksTahsildar: Endorsement issued by the Tahsildar, Amadalavalasa (R.C. No. 309/2024.A) on 31-08-2024, on PGRS application SKL20240819426 dated 19-08-2024 filed by Ponnada Jogarao S/o Appalarao, Nellimarla village, Vizianagaram district (Aadhaar 822319338128), seeking handover of 3.13 cents of land in Akkivaram village, Amadalavalasa mandal (Sy. Nos. 3/2, 10/1A, 10/1B and 34/15), said to have been acquired through a gift deed. Field enquiry by the Mandal Revenue Inspector and Village Revenue Officer found the land in the long-standing possession/cultivation of other named parties, per SLR practical-survey records going back about 20 years, and found that settling the dispute would require altering registered-document and pattadar records, which the department cannot do administratively.
